yahoo.terms_version: Yahoo Terms of Service, last updated 1 November 2026; UK and EMEA users contract with Yahoo International Limited (Dublin), Irish law

uses.basis: Automated collection is barred (ToS s2(d)(ix)), so nothing collected that way may lawfully be stored. Gold CSV downloads are described as for offline use, but no clause grants a retention right; s2(h) bars reproduction without written permission.
No clause on training models with Yahoo content. s6(b)(iii) only concerns Yahoo's own AI features. s2(d)(x) bars building a competing database from Yahoo or its data providers' material.
No non-display concept in the consumer terms. Scheduled automated monitoring would itself be automated access (s2(d)(ix)).
Personal, non-commercial viewing by the owner is the consumer service itself (s2(e)). Showing the owner data that was collected by automated means is not cured by the display being private.

uses.manual_gold_csv_route: silent for owner-only derived views; forbidden for export or display to anyone else
uses.basis: Yahoo help: you must not redistribute information displayed on or provided by Yahoo Finance. s2(h) bars distribution, transmission or publication without written permission.

uses.manual_gold_csv_route: silent; raw data likely caught by s2(h) 'transmit'
uses.basis: No AI-provider clause. s2(h) bars transmitting any portion of the Services without explicit written permission. finance.yahoo.com robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai crawlers (crawling, not processing, but a clear signal).

official_products.name: Yahoo Finance Gold
official_products.what: Manual CSV download of historical data from a quote's Historical Data page; '40+ years of downloadable data'; export of chart data tables. Not an API. Some instruments have no download because of data licensing restrictions.
official_products.data_licence: None beyond the consumer Terms of Service; no clause grants storage, training or AI use.

official_products.name: Yahoo Finance Silver / Bronze
official_products.what: No historical download or export listed.

official_products.name: Yahoo Developer Network API terms (REV 3-2022)
official_products.what: Generic API terms; no finance data API is offered under them that we could find. They bar earning income from the APIs and require deletion of Yahoo user data within 24 hours unless marked storable.

yfinance_status.own_disclaimer: Not affiliated with, endorsed or vetted by Yahoo; for research and educational purposes; says Yahoo's API is intended for personal use only; tells users to read Yahoo's terms.
yfinance_status.yahoo_statement: No Yahoo statement about yfinance found. Yahoo's ToS s2(d)(ix) bars automated collection without express prior permission, and https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/robots.txt and https://query2.finance.yahoo.com/robots.txt both disallow every path for every user agent.

yahoo.upstream: Yahoo lists ICE Data Services as provider for LSE (.L, 20 min delay), NSE (.NS), BSE (.BO, 15 min) and US venues; mutual fund prices have no listed provider. https://help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN2310.html (checked 2 Nov 2026).
yahoo.recommendation: Remove Yahoo from ARC-01's automated data mix. Keep the Yahoo adapter disabled: the current terms forbid automated collection outright, so no personal use the adapter could serve is permitted. A Yahoo Finance Gold subscription (about GBP 38/month equivalent with tax) buys manual CSV downloads only, with no storage, training or AI grant, so it is not worth buying for MP. At most, the owner may look at Yahoo pages by hand as an unrecorded cross-check. Re-open only with Yahoo's written permission.

alternatives.name: Twelve Data (reference, Grow)
alternatives.markets: US; LSE (XLON), NSE (XNSE), BSE (XBOM) at EOD from Grow; mutual fund NAV only on Pro ($229)
alternatives.storage: s16.1 retain only for the duration the subscription permits; s16.2(a) delete within 30 days of termination
alternatives.display: Grow labelled internal display; external display needs a redistribution add-on (s2.2(e))
alternatives.ai_use: silent; s2.3(b) bars transferring data to third parties except as permitted
alternatives.fit: Covers UK and India listings; does not cover India or UK fund NAVs below Pro.

alternatives.name: Alpha Vantage
alternatives.markets: US; London (.LON) and BSE (.BSE) shown in docs; NSE not shown; 'stocks, ETFs and mutual funds' claimed globally, fund coverage for UK and India unverified
alternatives.delay: EOD daily series; realtime/15-min US needs entitlement
alternatives.history: 25+ years; free keys get 'compact' (last 100 points) only; 'full' and adjusted daily are premium
alternatives.display: personal use covers private 'investment analysis, research, testing, monitoring'; anything giving others access is commercial
alternatives.personal_definition: Commercial if you work for or are affiliated with an adviser, broker, bank, insurer or money manager (s2(a)(iv)).
alternatives.fit: Best stated personal-use grant of any vendor checked; free tier (25 requests/day) can carry ~20 daily updates once history is backfilled on one premium month.

owner_questions: Do you accept removing Yahoo from ARC-01's automated mix and keeping the adapter disabled, rather than buying Yahoo Finance Gold (about GBP 38/month with tax) for manual CSV downloads that carry no storage or training grant?

Are you, for data-licence purposes, a private individual with no employment or affiliation with an adviser, broker, bank, insurer or money manager? Alpha Vantage, EODHD and the exchanges classify users this way, and the answer decides personal or professional pricing.
Which India mutual funds and UK funds (ISINs) do you hold or want to track? Coverage can only be checked against named funds.

May MP ask AMFI in writing for permission to store NAV history, use it for model training and show derived results to you only? Until then, should India fund NAVs come only from your own consolidated account statements (CAS) for funds you hold?
Will you accept a second paid source of about GBP 20 to 24 a month (EODHD Historian) alongside Twelve Data Grow, inside the GBP 100 ceiling, to cover UK fund NAVs and act as a cross-check?
NSE's website terms bar use for 'simulation activities' and any automated collection. Do you agree MP never fetches NSE website files and relies on a licensed vendor for NSE prices?
vendor_questions: Yahoo: Is there any licence, paid or otherwise, under which an individual may download Yahoo Finance daily prices by automated means, store them indefinitely, train private models on them and send derived values to a contracted AI processor (Anthropic)? Does a Yahoo Finance Gold CSV download carry any right to store or process the file beyond personal viewing?

AMFI: May a private individual download NAVAll.txt and the NAV history daily by script, store the full history, use it to train private forecasting models, and show derived results only to himself, including processing by a contracted AI provider? If so, on what terms and attribution?

NSE Data & Analytics: What is the price and licence for end-of-day equity data for one non-professional individual, permitting storage, private model training and owner-only derived display? Does 'simulation activities' cover private backtesting?
BSE: Does the website disclaimer permit a private individual to store downloaded bhavcopy files and train private models? Is there an individual end-of-day licence and its price?

Alpha Vantage: Under the personal licence, may I store the full daily history indefinitely, train private ML models on it, and send derived values (not raw series) to Anthropic's API for summarisation? Do you cover NSE (not just BSE), and are LSE prices in GBX or GBP?

EODHD: Under the personal plan, may derived values and short raw extracts be sent to Anthropic's API as a processor for my own use? Do you currently supply end-of-day data for LSE, NSE and BSE on the Historian plan? Which plan includes EUFUND UK fund NAVs, how far back, and are prices including VAT for a UK buyer?
Marketstack: Do you cover XLON, XNSE and XBOM end-of-day? After a subscription ends, may stored data be kept? May it be used for private model training and sent to an AI processor?
Twelve Data: Does Grow include any India or UK fund NAVs, or only Pro? Are LSE prices returned in GBX or GBP?
